name: Linux POSIX text tools
description: Native mawk for SDK pre-build text processing and the managed POSIX awk alias.
notes: Adds mawk 1.3.4.20200120-3.1 without changing published runtime/build-tools releases. Raw Debian data only; no alternatives or maintainer scripts run. Qualification executes awk with array and loop syntax used by JieLi pre_build.
